\section{Introduction to MMIX and Algorithms}

This document serves as an exhaustive mathematical and systems-level study of Donald Knuth's \textit{The Art of Computer Programming}.

\subsection{Algorithm E (Euclid's Algorithm)}
Given two positive integers $m$ and $n$, find their greatest common divisor.

\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{E1. [Find remainder]} Divide $m$ by $n$ and let $r$ be the remainder. ($0 \le r < n$).
    \item \textbf{E2. [Is it zero?]} If $r = 0$, the algorithm terminates; $n$ is the answer.
    \item \textbf{E3. [Reduce]} Set $m \leftarrow n$, $n \leftarrow r$, and go back to step E1.
\end{itemize}
